## GAISE Recommendations

Update to the GAISE Report: <https://asacollegegaise.org>

Ten GAISE Recommendations for Introductory Statistics and Data Science <https://asacollegegaise.org/recommendations> Note: Click on a recommendation to bring up a more detailed explanation.

## Simulation Based Inference

Tim Hesterberg Articles: [What Teachers Should Know About the Bootstrap: Resampling in the Undergraduate Statistics Curriculum](ttps://amstat.tandfonline.com/doi/abs/10.1080/00031305.2015.1089789#.WwQ6X4pG1hE)
